headlines.title: ConocoPhillips to Exit Norway in $4.4 Billion Deal With Vår Energi
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips has agreed to sell its Norwegian oil and gas business and a UK terminal stake to Vår Energi in a $4.425 billion deal, accelerating consolidation in Norway's offshore energy industry.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips Agrees $4.4 Billion Norway Sale to Vår Energi
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips is selling its Norwegian oil and gas operations and UK infrastructure assets to Vår Energi in a major North Sea deal.

headlines.title: ConocoPhillips announces agreement to sell Norway business and Teesside asset to Vår Energi
headlines.summary: HOUSTON, November 23, 2026--ConocoPhillips announces agreement to sell Norway business and Teesside asset to Vår Energi

headlines.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For ConocoPhillips Stock Could Change Following Earnings And Dividend Hike
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$20.1b and net income of US$4.0b, alongside an 11% lift in its regular quarterly dividend to US$0.93 per share. The mix of higher earnings, steady production from key Lower 48 assets, and a larger cash return commitment signals management confidence in the underlying cash generation profile. This article will examine how ConocoPhillips' investment narrative is affected by this stronger earnings result and higher ordinary dividend.

headlines.title: State Street Energy SPDR (XLE) Sells $174.6 Million of Exxon on Wednesday
headlines.summary: The $39.74 billion fund sold $727.9 million of stock and bought nothing, cutting all 21 of its positions.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
